limitations: Published solar-term time resolution is one minute; do not infer exact seconds.
The KASI table provides astronomical/calendar facts, not scientific evidence for fortune-telling prediction.
Saju year/month/day/hour pillar policies, unknown birth hour handling, yaja-si and true solar time are separate declared implementation policies.
KASI ephemerides and the target app may share underlying astronomical models; this is external published-source validation, not proven mathematical independence of all computational ancestors.
Minute-level comparison should report signed/absolute minute deviations and mismatches; exact-minute boundary birth cases need explicit precision handling.
